acceptance: `evolve ratchet check size` on a fixture module with a function over its allowance exits 1 naming it (red: unknown command)
The command and the package tests share one scan function
`evolve ratchet check` passes on the current tree, as the package tests do
fix: Add `evolve ratchet check [size|rawgit]` (default: both). It scans the module the way the package tests do, calls each Check, and prints every function over its allowance, every new offender and every raw-git site over baseline. Exit 0 when clean, 1 on any violation, 2 when the scan fails. The command and the package tests share one scan function. Put R3's tighten in the same group as `evolve ratchet tighten`, one group for both ratchets, and update the design doc's R3 row to that spelling. Document it in runtime-reference.md.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: sizeratchet.Check and rawgitratchet.Check (sizeratchet.go:141, rawgitratchet.go:204) are called only from their packages' tests, which scan the module. A console landing runs `go test ./internal/sizeratchet ./internal/rawgitratchet` by hand, and a comment-reduction round that skipped it turned CI red. The designed single writer of offenders.json, `evolve sizeratchet tighten` (logic-first-delivery-design.md §5.13, R3), has no command group yet either.
title: The size and raw-git ratchets run only as `go test` on their packages; add `evolve ratchet check` so a landing runs the same check CI runs
